comment: potion.c H2Opotion_dip() 1573, 1577, 1580-1581 (with mkobj.c costly_alteration() 802) and read.c recharge() 832: a debug Archeologist arrives inside a Dlvl 3 general store (seed from a port scan of 8810001-8810150), wishes for an uncursed +0 ring of adornment and a potion of holy water, sells both to the keeper by dropping them, and picks them back up, so both are unpaid shop goods. A wished scroll of charging adds a charge to the unpaid ring, so recharge() raises its bill (832, alter_cost). Dipping the unpaid holy water into wished unholy water unblesses it: H2Opotion_dip() sees an unpaid potion of water with COST_UNBLSS and calls costly_alteration() ('You unbless that clear potion, you pay for it!').
